method.source: Déposants des brevets, resource 7744f1fc-f7be-40cb-9511-2ca6e7ce5031 (MESR, data.gouv.fr), queried via France_Open_Data MCP Tabular API
method.n_applications: rows matched by SIREN (applicant rows; an application can appear twice e.g. Owkin France + Owkin Inc). For name matches, distinct applications.
method.years: Parsed from key_appln_nr: FR/EP and EP-validation (T) keys use 2-digit year; US/CN/AU/JP/KR/MX 4-digit; WO keys are PCT application numbers (e.g. WO2017051519WFR = PCT/FR2017/051519) so year = PCT filing year (confirmed against Demandes de brevets dates); CA/IL/NL keys carry no year.
method.name_search: filter contains is case-insensitive (IKTOS==Iktos). Rejected: "Rivercell" matched only Nutrivercell (unrelated).
method.persons: No individual-person applicants appeared in any family queried; dataset appears to list only legal entities (or persons are absent).
